title: Three counts, two geometries
promptMarkdown: For [Co(en)₃]Cl₃ (neutral bidentate en), K₄[Fe(CN)₆], and neutral [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂], find complex charge, metal oxidation state, formal d count (Co group9, Fe8, Pt10) and coordination number. Sketch possible cis/trans donor arrangements for the square-planar platinum complex. Explain why counting ligand molecules would give a wrong coordination number for the cobalt complex.
hintLadder: Use the counterions to find bracket charge.
Subtract ligand charges to obtain oxidation state.
en contributes two attached donor atoms.

criteria.criterion: Distinguishes ionic charge, oxidation state and d count
